Release Candidate 1: picking a track is instant again, folding into the compact player and back is a smooth blur, double-clicking the top edge of the window zooms it again, and the compact player always opens in the middle of the screen. Beta 1 made shuffle let go when you turn it off, kept the display's animation up when you switch desktops and turn down, and kept the compact player's artwork in place. Release candidates are offered only to people who turned on Receive beta updates.
### Added
- **Quick EQ moves between faders.** With a fader lit, the Left and Right arrows, or A and D, light the one beside it, so you can work across the whole equalizer from the keyboard. It stops at the first and last band.
### Changed
- **Folding into the compact player goes out of focus and back.** The console blurs, the window changes size, and the new view comes into focus already at its final size. The window no longer jumps part of the way or stutters when you unfold it. - **The compact player opens in the middle of the screen.** Folding into it already did; starting CrateDigger in the compact player now does too, wherever you last left it.
### Fixed
- **Selecting is instant again.** Clicking a track, an album or an artist, or moving with the arrow keys, could take most of a second to respond in a large library. - **Double-clicking the top edge of the window works again.** On macOS 27 it did nothing. It now zooms the window, or expands the compact player to the full console, following your Desktop & Dock setting. - **Turning shuffle off really turns it off.** Next and Previous kept following the shuffled order until you played something else. Turning shuffle off now puts what is playing back in its album, crate or playlist order, and turning it on shuffles everything still to come. The song playing carries on either way. - **The display's animation no longer freezes when you switch desktops.** Coming back to the desktop CrateDigger is on left the LED animation stuck on its last frame until the next song started. - **The animation follows the volume properly.** Turning the volume down a little made the bars drop almost to nothing. They now fall by as much as the sound does. - **Album art stays in its frame in the compact player.** A cover that is not perfectly square, or a YouTube thumbnail, spilled out of its frame and ran into the display. - **Quick EQ keeps hold of the fader you moved to.** Moving the pointer off the fader you first pointed at no longer lets go of the one the keys moved to, as long as it stays over the equalizer.

Beta 1: shuffle lets go when you turn it off, the display's animation keeps up when you switch desktops and turn down, and the compact player keeps its artwork in place. Betas are offered only to people who turned on Receive beta updates.
### Added
- **Quick EQ moves between faders.** With a fader lit, the Left and Right arrows, or A and D, light the one beside it, so you can work across the whole equalizer from the keyboard. It stops at the first and last band.
### Fixed
- **Turning shuffle off really turns it off.** Next and Previous kept following the shuffled order until you played something else. Turning shuffle off now puts what is playing back in its album, crate or playlist order, and turning it on shuffles everything still to come. The song playing carries on either way. - **The display's animation no longer freezes when you switch desktops.** Coming back to the desktop CrateDigger is on left the LED animation stuck on its last frame until the next song started. - **The animation follows the volume properly.** Turning the volume down a little made the bars drop almost to nothing. They now fall by as much as the sound does. - **Album art stays in its frame in the compact player.** A cover that is not perfectly square, or a YouTube thumbnail, spilled out of its frame and ran into the display. - **Quick EQ keeps hold of the fader you moved to.** Moving the pointer off the fader you first pointed at no longer lets go of the one the keys moved to, as long as it stays over the equalizer.

A small update that tidies how the window sizes and sits on screen.
### Fixed
- **The window keeps its minimum size while you drag it.** It could be dragged far narrower than the console fits, which cut off the controls along the bottom. It now stops at 1200 by 820 points, or the size of the screen if that is smaller. - **The compact player opens in the middle of the screen.** Folding the console into the compact player used to leave it hanging from the full window's top corner, or wherever you last left it. It now lands centred, at the width you last gave it. - **POSITION and VOLUME sit evenly in the bottom bar.** On a wide window the two faders used to crowd the transport keys and leave a wide empty gap at each end. Each one now sits in the middle of its half, with the same space to the window's edge as to the keys.
